description: The cap is off by one: data one byte over the cap is held whole
old: /\ form' = IF ~Carried(c, k) THEN "none" ELSE IF n <= Cap THEN "whole" ELSE "cut"
new: /\ form' = IF ~Carried(c, k) THEN "none" ELSE IF n <= Cap + 1 THEN "whole" ELSE "cut"

description: A cut leaves out the marker that says the data was cut
The cut falls inside a character
A -32042's data is kept, though its URLs are the user's to answer
A null data is kept as data
The host keeps the whole data before it cuts it
old: /\ held' = IF ~Carried(c, k) THEN 0 ELSE IF n <= Cap THEN n ELSE 2 + p + e
new: /\ held' = IF ~Carried(c, k) THEN 0 ELSE n

description: A log line carries the data
The cap bounds the raw prefix and not its escaped form, so escapes push a cut past the cap
A cut keeps far less than fits
